title: india_lp Coherence-Analysis Finding Record
description: One empirical finding from directly reading two or more official Indian curriculum documents (national NCF/NCERT syllabi, or a state framework): a gap, a working cross-reference, or a divergence. Modeled on deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's coherence-finding-record.schema.json. No records exist under this schema yet as of this repo's founding session (2026-09-30) -- founding-session work was scoped to non-text institutional/licensing groundwork (see README.md), not yet a direct comparative reading of curriculum documents.

findingType.description: Same core vocabulary as deutsche_lp's findingType, replacing its 16-Land grade-placement categories with 'state-vs-national-divergence' (India's central-vs-state structure is not a same-kind comparison the way German Laender are to each other), and adding 'licensing-terms-divergence' -- a finding that two Indian jurisdictions (e.g. Karnataka vs. Maharashtra) hold genuinely different redistribution rights over structurally similar content, which this repo's founding research already found real evidence of (see docs/source-notes/2026-09-30-india-curriculum-licensing-landscape-research.md).

excerptText.description: A short verbatim excerpt grounding the object, where one exists in the source doc.

accessTier.description: How much of this object's source document this record actually keeps in excerptText -- same four values as deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's identical field. See the repo-wide default explained in policy-timeline-event.schema.json's accessTier description.

licenseOrRightsNote.description: The legal basis for storing excerptText at the accessTier chosen above.

themes.description: Open string list, same rationale as nys_lp's themes field -- this repo's theme taxonomy has not yet stabilized.
